desc:
The Lion and the Hare: an animated moral story for kids from Kalila & Dimna, the ancient book of Persian fables. Can a tiny hare outsmart the biggest lion in the forest?

A cruel lion rules the forest, and every day one animal must become his dinner. Today it is the little hare's turn... but the hare has a clever idea. Watch what happens when the lion meets "another lion" at the bottom of a deep well!

Moral of the story: Wisdom is stronger than strength.

CHAPTERS
0:00 The cruel lion of the forest
0:20 The little hare's turn
0:35 Off to the old well
0:50 The lion's big leap

ABOUT KALILA & DIMNA
Kalila & Dimna is a book of animal fables that began as the ancient Indian Panchatantra. It was translated into Middle Persian, then into Arabic by Ibn al-Muqaffa, and later into Persian, becoming one of the most widely translated story collections in the world.

This is an original animated adaptation of a public-domain classic. The script, animation, character voices and santur music were all made for this channel, to share the wisdom of Persian storytelling with children everywhere.

Next episode: The Monkey and the Tortoise.
